prompt: Resume a paused orchestrate run without silently skipping real work when a task index is reused across different plans.

eval.contract: When a completed-task index is reused by the current plan under a different title, _cross_check_skip_list must route it to the ambiguous set (forcing a re-run) rather than the safe_to_skip set, guarding against silently re-running unrelated work as well as silently skipping real work.
